```python
import pandas as pd

# Read the quotes.csv file
quotes = pd.read_csv('quotes.csv')

# Convert the date column to datetime format
quotes['date'] = pd.to_datetime(quotes['date'])

# Pivot the data to have dates as rows and tickers as columns
pivot_quotes = quotes.pivot(index='date', columns='ticker', values='close')

# Calculate daily returns
returns = pivot_quotes.pct_change().dropna()

# Calculate mean returns and volatilities
mean_returns = returns.mean()
volatilities = returns.std()

# Calculate the correlation matrix
correlation_matrix = returns.corr()

# Display the results
print("Mean Returns:")
print(mean_returns)
print("\nVolatilities:")
print(volatilities)
print("\nCorrelation Matrix:")
print(correlation_matrix)
```
